rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: WINbur
Exhibition name: American Dream ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Joseph F. Winchel (United States, 1987).
Introduced in United States by Co-Operative Rose Growers in 1990 as 'American Dream'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Mild, damask fragrance. 30 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, exhibition, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Large, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, upright. Large, semi-glossy, medium green, leathery foliage.

Height: up to 5½' (up to 165cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower, exhibition or garden. Vigorous. produces decorative hips. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
